basic_info.description: $300K price drop, now only $1,095,000 ..Experience Waterfront living from this top-floor, tri-level loft condo in the vibrant Dogpatch's Waterfront neighborhood. This professionally maintained home offers a flexible floor plan with approximately 1,500 square feet, featuring 2 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, & 1-car parking. Loft includes in-unit laundry & 2 patios. Inside, expansive double-height windows, amazing skylights, & dramatic ceilings frame the entertainment rooms with spectacular views of Crane Cove park & the bay. The main level boasts a gourmet kitchen with stainless steel appliances, quartz countertops & elegant pendant lights. The dining room leads to a generous living room with bamboo floors, high ceilings, & a gas fireplace, perfect for entertaining & enjoying the stunning PARK , beach & Waterfront views. On the upper level, you'll find an office loft & a charming ensuite bedroom with a private bath & patio. The lower level features a spacious bedroom with a private deck & a large bath equipped with his-and-her sinks, a shower, & a soaking tub. This prime location offers easy access to UCSF Mission Bay,Chase Center, Giants Ballpark, major highways & Crane Cove Park. Don't miss this exceptional opportunity to own a piece of the Dogpatch's Waterfront
